subhead: Our own room, every Monday at the Log Cabin Bar & Grill in Olympia. Twelve spots, eight minutes each. Message us to lock one down, or show up at 6:00 PM and take your chances.
motto: Message us, show up, go up.

poster.alt: Log Cabin Comedy Open Mic flyer. The Stoned Goose lockup above the title, every Monday, 12 spots at 8 minutes each, sign ups at 6 PM, show starts at 7 PM, at the Log Cabin Bar & Grill, 7035 Pacific Ave SE, Olympia, WA 98503.

signup.heading: Message us. Get a spot.
signup.body: Send us a DM on Instagram or an email with your name and which Monday you want. We will write back and the spot is yours.
signup.walkUpNote: No spot locked? Show up spots open at 6:00 PM on the night, first come first served, for whatever is left.

howItWorks.heading: Message us.
howItWorks.body: DM us on Instagram or email us with your name and the Monday you want. Twelve spots a night. Once we confirm, it is yours.

howItWorks.heading: Eight minutes.
howItWorks.body: Eight, not nine, not a quick one more. Show up sign ups open at 6:00 PM, show starts at 7:00 PM. Running order goes up the night of, so get there early enough to find out where you are.

howItWorks.heading: Then stay.
howItWorks.body: The comics who stick around for the rest of the list are the comics who get better. Work the room, watch the room.
